name: Catalog Migrator
tagline: Relocates a full Shopify or CSV product catalogue, with a dry-run mapping first
description: Bring a product list from Shopify or a CSV and it maps the whole thing onto the shop you are moving to, products and images included. The mapping lands as a dry run you review and approve before anything goes live. Then it wires up purchase links and a redirect plan, so customers never hit dead ends mid-move.
author: ColinMcDermott
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
